owner_approval.source: Tamam onayliyorum Codex — explicit approval after the concrete four EO05D jobs were listed: yesterday/today bootstrap; replace same-day value3 with5 rather than sum8; duplicate-safe durable completion; raw-to-physical report comparison/mismatch record. Code, necessary SQL preparation, isolated tests and ONE PR; no live DB/provider/config/merge/deploy.

bootstrap.eligibility: Day crossing eligibleFromMs is unavailable; no fabricated partial-day or disconnected backfill policy
bootstrap.advance: Only current DB-confirmed exact owner/date/timezone receipt; clone or unknown stops
bootstrap.native_dispatch: existing admitted reader supplied by trusted server composition; no new HTTP/scheduler activation

reconciliation.input: Actual current-owner physical AEAD/source/context validation and existing fixed provider projectors; no caller rows
reconciliation.coverage: All complete two/three datasets and every page; existing holds cannot consume or replace
reconciliation.CAS: Expected prior day revision, unique source/operation, actual source read clocks newer than previous completion
reconciliation.replacement: Replace same native key value, never add; remove vanished rows only for verified complete same-owner/provider/account/connection/day/timezone scope
reconciliation.physical_verification: Recompute canonical digest from actual typed fact values after write, then atomic source consumed + consumer receipt + day checkpoint
reconciliation.checkpoint_scope: Exact source-to-Dataset day acceptance, not scheduler job completion/release
reconciliation.unknown: One write; lost reply never triggers automatic inspect/retry/new attempt
reconciliation.mismatch: Subtransaction rolls fact/consumption/head back; minimal mismatch ledger remains on pending new source
reconciliation.history: Previous encrypted source untouched; superseded storage/empty/D consumer receipts cannot claim current data or finality

privacy_retention: Existing synchronized3-year fixed report/source retention, source proof and mandatory scoped erasure remain binding; no new PII/archive/cleanup activation

native_holds.meta_nonempty_sales: Existing meta_sales_semantics_unproven holds; empty read is separately provable

verification.SQL: tools/eo05d-reconciliation-probe.mjs inside existing F01 rollback; actual SQL/AEAD/private-role profiles, synthetic native/owner/keys

minimum_reread_policy.owner_approval: Tamam Codex mutabıkız — approved the two-hour hourly window and separate initial X=1 and Y=1 daily reconciliation plan.
minimum_reread_policy.supersedes: The earlier proposal to reread yesterday and today each hour. Initial bootstrap still reads yesterday before today.

hourly.window: At the hourly boundary, read the two most recently completed hours as a half-open interval. Use elapsed hour boundaries with unambiguous offsets across daylight-saving transitions.
hourly.eligibility: Only metrics with verified hourly granularity in the exact provider query and mapping. Daily-only metrics use daily reconciliation.
hourly.overlap: Replace a matching verified hourly fact with the newer complete result for the same scope. Do not add repeated hours or sum daily snapshots with hourly facts.

yesterday.scope: Complete previous provider-calendar day, first read after accounting for provider reporting lag.

today.scope: Current provider-calendar day through the read time.

daily.scheduling: Distribute both jobs across low-commerce periods for the relevant shops, interpreting source dates in the provider account calendar.
daily.adjust_frequency: Measure changes after the first reconciliation before adding reads.

minimum_reread_policy.measurement: Compare the same shop and provider workloads for whole-day versus two-hour reads. Measure API calls, rows, bytes, provider read time and database write time before treating the policy as a capacity result.
minimum_reread_policy.older_dates: Keep the existing daily reconciliation path for applicable unresolved dates whose provider metrics are still subject to historical revision. Limit coverage per provider, account and conversion action to evidenced attribution settings plus any separately evidenced reporting lag.
minimum_reread_policy.unknown: Represent unverified settings or reporting semantics explicitly as unknown. Do not assume a default attribution window or finality, or activate a new historical read based on an example.
minimum_reread_policy.date_basis: Use conversion date for metrics with verified query and mapping support. Keep interaction-date metrics distinct and preserve their reconciliation requirements.

google.readiness: Google Ads v25 documents conversion-date fields. Verify the exact existing resource, segments and query together, preserve old encrypted records, and keep date basis explicit through projection before enabling.
google.cart_sales: Conversion-date equivalents for cart-data product units and revenue are unverified. Retain current semantics.

minimum_reread_policy.meta_and_klaviyo: Retain existing report semantics and holds. A date basis confirmed for one endpoint does not establish it for another endpoint or product breakdown.

isolated_implementation.verified_hour_application: Pure transition over one already scoped hourly series. Daily state never enters the transition. Durable writer and readback are not wired.
isolated_implementation.windows: Daily windows are supplied by the caller, with previous-day reporting lag included. Once-per-day claiming belongs to scheduler integration.
pending: Production schedule configuration, PostgreSQL rollover proof, and hourly dispatch integration
isolated_implementation.scheduler: Trusted optional daily schedule policy uses the durable queue tick and accepts only a single matching day through existing fenced daily preflight.
isolated_implementation.daily_identity: Fixed account and install generation, daily slot kind, provider-calendar schedule date and report date. Queue hour and queue timestamp do not rekey the job. Existing persistent run identity and quota-wait rules still govern reservation and resumption.

postgres_rollover_probe.expected: Later queue hour cannot reserve the same daily job. Exactly one durable run remains. The probe uses a synthetic denial before ads data access and rolls its fixture back.

hourly_sql_prototype.boundary: Logged PostgreSQL rehearsal table, physical readback and rollback. No application migration, provider payload or durable production writer.
hourly_sql_prototype.verification: Overlapping, empty, stale, invalid, cross-account and daily isolation cases use synthetic snapshots.
hourly_sql_prototype.job_receipt: Account, job ID, fence and exact two hours are checked against the locked test work order. Hour writes, order completion and receipt insertion share one statement. The probe separately reads the stored receipt.
hourly_sql_prototype.production_dependency: Current verified raw receipts and admission bindings identify a single calendar date, with fixed provider query schemas. A versioned hourly range and verified provider capability must be bound to the source and job before scheduling or enabling production SQL.

klaviyo_hourly_query.request: Fixed datetime >= start and datetime < end for exact two-hour admitted range. Cursor progression preserves the same bounds.
klaviyo_hourly_query.evidence_input: Versioned scope binds workspace, installation generation, account, job, fence, metric, timezone and exact bounds independently of access token or pagination cursor.
klaviyo_hourly_query.pending: Current authority check, immutable source scope persistence and readback, admitted dispatch, and durable hourly write remain open. Existing daily aggregation and reporting endpoints keep their date semantics.

encrypted_page.binding: The fixed native projection and exact source scope share one versioned authenticated source envelope; ownership uses the existing source cipher owner binding.
encrypted_page.readback: An exact expected scope, owner, attempt and page ordinal are required; the retained event datetime must belong to the half-open range and the event's metric must match.
encrypted_page.pending: Wire the versioned page through a current hourly claim, whole-batch manifest and durable receipt SQL. This page codec does not issue or confirm a storage receipt.

batch.proof: Exact query scope, attempt, ordered page hashes and row/byte counts; authenticated readback rechecks pagination, duplicate event IDs and coverage. Empty terminal page is distinguishable from missing evidence.
batch.pending: Runtime EXECUTE is absent. The positive source proof is isolated. Product scheduling, end-to-end binding, compatibility with privacy erasure/retention, and durable hourly report consumption remain open.
batch.commit_flow: One private repository commit per prepared capability. The receipt must echo the attempt and expected digest. Only a known receipt permits bounded physical readback. Unknown commit result never triggers readback or retry. Source verification does not close the report job.
batch.isolated_repository: PostgreSQL fixture adapter checks and locks the same unclosed hourly work order before writing, then returns the committed digest and bounded ordered pages.

private_writer.proof: Checks current owner, exact hour interval encoded in claim partition, local date coverage, eligibility, deadline and recorded quota authority under existing locks. Stores only hourly source pages using the existing private evidence tables, and returns the persisted scoped manifest.

roundtrip.cases: Current PostgreSQL work binding plus quota and entitlement, stale fence rejection, encrypted source tables and physical receipt readback. The transaction fixture is rolled back.
roundtrip.boundary: Test the accepted 256-character metric ID without exceeding PostgreSQL regex bounds.

klaviyo_hourly_event_report.metric: Count of distinct verified Klaviyo Ordered Product events in each completed hour
klaviyo_hourly_event_report.source: Only authenticated physical source readback produces the one-use in-process input. SQL verifies the current claim, complete owner-bound source, manifest digest and totals.
klaviyo_hourly_event_report.write: Two hour keys are separate from daily facts. Newer source observations may replace an overlapping hour. Readback checks the physical written values against the retained receipt.
klaviyo_hourly_event_report.pending: Rollback-only schema. No product grant, scheduler activation or job closure. Hourly privacy erasure, source retention integration and workload benchmark are open.

klaviyo_window_capacity.cohort: Same 500 synthetic stores, 500 distinct products per store, one event per product per day. Compare the full day to the final two completed hours and alternate pass order.
klaviyo_window_capacity.boundaries: Klaviyo Ordered Product only. No network/provider time, report or queue load, other providers, throughput claim, or production activation.

klaviyo_product_acceptance.owner_decision: Expose all Klaviyo analytical dataset fields in the user report, preserving account, campaign or flow, message, variation, channel, role and sold product relationships.
klaviyo_product_acceptance.current_delivery: Hourly source product, variant, quantity, native value and exact available campaign/flow, message and variation IDs use the existing Klaviyo projection rules and are written with their verified report receipt. Missing quantity/value and unresolved hierarchy remain explicit.
klaviyo_product_acceptance.pending: Resolve known message, names, medium and product metadata from the daily analytical dataset and bind daily and hourly records once to the user report. Verify the full hierarchy, reconciliation, and visual acceptance before claiming completion.
